blocks.text: Los Angeles, United States — LeBron James powered the Philadelphia 76ers past the reigning champion New York Knicks 98-93, scoring 20 points, including a crucial late tip-in, on Friday. The 76ers picked up their second win against the Knicks this season, building on their opening-night triumph that spoiled New York’s banner-raising at Madison Square Garden. The win had a double edge as Friday’s games marked the start of the fourth edition of the NBA Cup, the NBA in-season tournament won by the Knicks before they went on to beat the San Antonio Spurs in the NBA Finals for their first championship […]...
